Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessModelAllocationBottleneckAnalyzer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelAllocationBottleneckAnalyzer
public final class ProcessModelAllocationBottleneckAnalyzer extends Object
Derives trace-qualified bottleneck-relief opportunities from a completed fixed-total allocation search.

The analyzer is read-only: it consumes immutable ProcessModelAllocationOptimizer.AllocationSearchResult evidence and performs no simulations, action writes, or process-model mutation. It retains only candidates whose selected objective improves on the best feasible sampled allocation by more than the search's declared objective tolerance and whose complete baseline restoration was verified. A general constraint reports the non-negative magnitude of its sampled negative margin. An installed-capacity constraint uses the immutable current and applicable-limit snapshot that also supplied normalized candidate feasibility. Relief therefore remains available for every discovered installed constraint, not only the subset selected as required hydraulic bindings; it is unavailable when that complete evidence is invalid.

A reported opportunity is an association in the finite sampled trace. It is not proof of causation, global optimality, a shadow price, production loss, economic value, or engineering approval. Relief values with different units are never aggregated or compared.

1.0
